request: Project managers should be able to see the full history of engagement with a country before starting a new mission.
pre_mortem: A year after launch, the feature led to a significant incident where a project manager accessed sensitive engagement data regarding diplomatic discussions that were not intended for their project's scope. This led to an unauthorized disclosure of confidential information to external stakeholders, resulting in a diplomatic fallout. Furthermore, the lack of clarity on which engagements were relevant resulted in erroneous assumptions, causing miscommunication between teams and adversely affecting operational decisions.
gaps: What criteria determine which components of engagement history are relevant to each project manager?
What safeguards are in place to ensure project managers do not access confidential information outside their scope of work?
How is engagement history compiled and what processes ensure the accuracy and reliability of this information?
What impact does role change or departure have on a project manager's access to past engagement data?
How will the criteria for authorized regional coordinators be defined and enforced?

proposals.summary: This release will enable project managers to access a comprehensive history of engagement with a country before initiating a new mission. It will support informed decision-making by organizing and displaying previous interactions and data relevant to each country within the Government CRM.

core_commitments.text: Project managers will have access to the full history of engagement with a country.
The engagement history will be displayed in a clear and organized manner for each country.

in_scope.text: The system will compile engagement history that includes meeting dates, attendees, discussion topics, and outcomes for every country.
Project managers will have a dedicated interface to view engagement histories for the 100 member countries.
The engagement history will be filtered to show only interactions relevant to the specific project manager's prior missions.
Access to this engagement data will be restricted to project managers and authorized regional coordinators.
The engagement history will include a date range filter to select relevant interactions.

out_of_scope.text: This release will not include modifications to the engagement data input process.
This release will not address changes to data retention policies for engagement history.
This release will not allow for exporting engagement histories outside the Government CRM.

assumptions.text: Project managers require access to historical engagement data to make informed decisions about new missions, as stated in the request.
Historical engagement data is reliably recorded within the Government CRM for all countries.
Users accessing engagement histories will have the appropriate security clearances to view sensitive information.
The Government CRM currently supports displaying filtered lists of data based on user roles.

definitions.text: 'Engagement history' means a record of all interactions with a specific country that includes meeting dates, attendees, discussion topics, and outcomes.
'Project manager' means a user role in the system responsible for leading missions and projects involving designated countries.

success_criteria.text: At least 80% of project managers report satisfaction with the ease of use of the engagement history interface, measured through a user feedback survey within one month of release.
